gloss: to come out ahead; to gain; to benefit

definitions.gloss: to come out ahead; to gain an advantage; to benefit
definitions.explanation: To end up better off than one otherwise would — paying less, getting extra value, or gaining some advantage. The direct opposite of {損|そん}をする.

examples.japanese: ⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{得|とく}をする。
examples.english: You come out ahead if you buy in bulk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧をした。
examples.english: I booked early, so I saved a thousand yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧や⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧{得|とく}をすること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: If you become a member, there are discounts and perks, so you often come out ahead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{得|とく}をする⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think you come out ahead in the end by speaking honestly.

notes:
The gain is usually financial, but it can be any advantage — time, reputation, or convenience. ⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧ also stands alone as a na-adjective (⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧な⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧, a good buy) and in the polite ⟦お{得|とく}→お得：07739_otoku⟧, which is everywhere in advertising.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ...⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{得|とく}をする: you come out ahead if ...
- ⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧をした⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧: the feeling of having gotten a good deal
- ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧をしない: nobody benefits

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{損|そん}をする→損をする：30214_sonwosuru⟧: to lose out — the direct opposite
- {儲|もう}かる: to make money — specifically monetary profit, usually from business
- ⟦{利益|りえき}を{得|え}る→利益を得る：30182_riekiwoeru⟧: to obtain a profit — formal, written register
